exposure: Fetal head position at the time of medication use
outcome: Success of slow-release dinoprostone vaginal insert for cervical ripening
cohort: 187 women who received dinoprostone vaginal inserts for cervical ripening
finding: A combined model incorporating height, amniotic fluid index, cephalic position, and Bishop score was a better predictor of cesarean section in women receiving dinoprostone vaginal inserts for cervical ripening compared to single factors alone.
